title: Umami Canadian Nectarine Crumble
description: A monsoon Canadian dessert featuring nectarines, lacquer glaze, and ayurvedic rajasic friendly ingredients, this umami crumble is a perfect treat for any time of the year. The combination of crunchy oats and sweet nectarines creates a delightful flavor experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the rolled oats, brown sugar, sesame seeds, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
Add the melted butter to the bowl and stir until the mixture is crumbly.
In a separate bowl, mix together the diced nectarines and lacquer glaze.
Transfer the nectarine mixture to a 9x9 inch baking dish.
Top the nectarine mixture with the crumbly oat mixture.
Bake the crumble in the preheated oven for 40 minutes.
Remove the crumble from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the crumble warm, garnished with additional sesame seeds if desired.
